hooks.text: 亲手组装飞船撑过二十一天并摧毁SpaceCorp源头，通关后可进入Endless继续叠加协同
hooks.excerpt: Build your own ship, survive 21 Days and destroy the source of SpaceCorp. Then, go Endless , find powerful synergies and try to get as far as possible!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 九艘飞船各有独立玩法，并通过升级和使用该船获胜来解锁专属技能
hooks.excerpt: Master 9 different ships, each one with unique gameplay. Unlock new skills by levelling up and winning with each ship.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 增量故事模式要求开采Cofferoid并偷取AstroCoffee种子，再用技能树持续强化飞船对抗SpaceCorp
hooks.excerpt: Astro Prospector is an incremental bullet hell about mining cofferoids and fighting the evil SpaceCorp. Collect resources, upgrade your ship and become unstoppable. Mine cofferoids from SpaceCorp's fields and steal their AstroCoffee seeds. Explore and upgrade the skill tree to increase your ship power.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
